Represent dark squares by \(X\) and white squares by \(\cdot\). The original board is

\[
\begin{matrix}
X&X&\cdot\\
\cdot&X&\cdot\\
\cdot&X&\cdot
\end{matrix}
\]

After a \(90^\circ\) clockwise turn, each original column, read from bottom to top, becomes a new row:

\[
\begin{matrix}
\cdot&\cdot&X\\
X&X&X\\
\cdot&\cdot&\cdot
\end{matrix}
\]

This pattern matches Board C.
